steps: Step 1 — Hard exercise makes muscles use oxygen fast. ↓
Step 2 — Oxygen running low means cells can’t do aerobic respiration. ↓
Step 3 — Cells switch to anaerobic respiration: Glucose → lactic acid + little energy. ↓
Step 4 — Lactic acid builds up, causing muscle fatigue.
